scope: Compact synchronous planning/progress metadata, real lazy-route requests, local cold-start byte/timing comparison and bilingual failure recovery. No deployment or real-mobile timing claim.

baselineAppJavaScript.source: Exact requested built scripts, compressed by the reproducible three-context measurement helper.

findings.before: engine.ts → academy-engine.ts → grammar.json forced the complete grammar teaching/exercise payload into synchronous progress hydration.
findings.after: academy-engine.ts validates diagnostic IDs using the generated planning metadata.

findings.before: engine.ts → study.ts → chapter-context.ts → arcade-scenes.json forced complete scene dialogue and choices into initial planning.
findings.after: chapter-context.ts checks actual scene turn IDs from compact metadata.

findings.before: Today callers needed full grammar and companion arrays for planning.
findings.after: dailyStudyPlan accepts structural compact catalogue arrays while preserving existing full-catalogue callers and their inferred return types.

omits: Lesson teaching, examples and full production models
Grammar exercise prompts, accepted answers, explanations and hints
Companion tasks, examples, models and the full source-page catalogue
Conversation prompts, options, dialogue, answers and feedback
Personal learner records and all private source files

reproduction.contentChangeRule: Regenerate after authored catalogue identity/order changes; the parity test and --check reject stale generated output.
reproduction.measurement: Run node scripts/measure_daily_loading.mjs baseline against the baseline build, then rebuild and run node scripts/measure_daily_loading.mjs after. Both use a localhost preview, default port5197.

compatibility.companionSelection: Original first practice page per grammar unit; subset preserves source ordering.
compatibility.assessmentValidation: Every existing exercise ID retained; invented diagnostic IDs remain rejected.

validation.initialEngineImportGraph: No curriculum.json, grammar.json, companion.json, enrichment.json or arcade-scenes.json reachable through static value imports.

limits: Local timing from disposable Chromium contexts is not a real mobile/network performance score. Exact initial/deferred resource requests and byte reduction are the acceptance measurements.
JSON projection size and emitted JavaScript bytes measure different things; both are reported separately.
Full teaching catalogues load with their study routes. Today and synchronous saved-progress hydration remain available without loading those payloads.
Forced static-script aborts exercise recovery but do not simulate every hosting or network failure.
Public deployment remains outside this local audit.

measurement.method: Three cold disposable Chromium contexts on localhost, with cache disabled by request routing. Initial Today remains fully usable; compressed bytes are computed from the exact requested built scripts.
measurement.limitations: Local timing is not a real mobile/network performance score. Byte reduction and deferred resource requests are the acceptance measurements.

checks.label: Cold EN/IT Today is usable and hydrates unfinished progress without requesting full teaching payloads
Ten direct lazy-route URLs load their study tools and preserve saved drafts
Forced lazy-JS failures show bilingual recovery; leaving the route and reloading both work without losing drafts
Owned synthetic browsers made no external requests or progress API calls; healthy journeys had no runtime errors

browserAudit.visualReview: Both390px failure screenshots inspected: translated explanation, retry button and main navigation remain readable and visible.
limitations: The forced fault aborts static lazy-script requests; it does not simulate every hosting/network failure.
The recovery button reloads the document, matching the user-facing instruction; synthetic saved work remains browser-local.
Byte/timing benchmarks are recorded separately; this audit verifies request boundaries and recovery behaviour.
browserAudit.finalBuildRerun: Repeated after the validated grammar-recall draft fix; all ten direct routes and both language failure/reload journeys passed on the final built asset.
